name: Molina de Aragón (Spain)
description: A white hoist stripe bearing the crowned municipal arms of Molina de Aragón (an arm holding a wheel and fleurs-de-lis on blue), the fly divided horizontally blue over red.
history: Municipal flag of Molina de Aragón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
